title: Navigation of a Quadrava application
description: Side menu organised in areas, up to three levels (group, subgroup, item). The menu works with permissions: roles stay in the identity provider. It is only a navigation convenience: enforcement stays in the screen's `requires` and in the back end.

default.description: Area opened at start-up, if the user can see it.

areas.description: Areas of the application, in order: each one is a part of the menu with its own groups and items. An area without visible items does not appear.

badges.description: Counters next to the menu items (for example «3» invoices to send): a GET that returns { "<item id>": number }. It is read again at intervals and when the user comes back to the page.

url.description: Relative path of the service (for example /api/menu/counters).

refreshSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, the counters are read again (60 if absent).

notifications.description: Messages for the user, behind a bell in the top bar with the number of unread ones: a GET that returns a list of { id, title, text, date, read, screen, params } (id and title required; date in ISO 8601; screen and params open a screen of the application). Read at once, at intervals and, with live, when its event stream says they changed.

url.description: Relative path of the service that lists the messages (for example /api/notifications).

readUrl.description: Relative path of a POST that marks messages as read, with the body { "ids": [ … ] }. Without it the messages are shown but cannot be marked as read.

live.description: Push updates: the runtime listens to this event stream (Server-Sent Events) and reads the messages again when one of its events arrives, also after a reconnection. The events only say that something changed. Without the platform service for event streams the messages are read at intervals only.

url.description: Path of the event stream on the same origin, for example /api/events/tasks; no expressions, query or host.

events.description: Names of the events (the event field of the stream) that read the messages again; the events without a name if absent.

refreshSeconds.description: How often, in seconds, the messages are read again (60 if absent).

userMenu.description: Items of the application in the user menu, before the built-in settings and sign-out: each one opens a screen with its parameters. Items the user may not see (requires, visibleIf) are left out.

settings.description: Sections of the application in the settings dialog, after the built-in «General» tab: each one is a tab that draws a screen of the application (for example a form read with a GET and saved with a PUT). Sections the user may not see (requires, visibleIf) are left out.

icon.description: Name of an icon of the built-in set (for example file-plus, search, package). An unknown name shows no icon.

id.description: Identifier of the area in kebab-case: the first part of the address of its screens. It does not change once published.

label.description: Text of the area in the menu: plain text or an expression such as {{ t('nav.orders', 'Orders') }}.

icon.description: Name of an icon of the built-in set (for example file-plus, search, package). An unknown name shows no icon.

requires.description: Permission (domain.resource.action) the user needs to see the area. The menu is only a convenience: the screen and the back end check permissions again.

visibleIf.description: Condition for showing the area, for example {{ settings.ordersEnabled }}; an error hides it. Always shown if absent.

items.description: Groups and items of the area, in order.

id.description: Identifier of the item in kebab-case.

label.description: Text of the item in the menu: plain text or an expression such as {{ t('nav.orders', 'Orders') }}.

icon.description: Name of an icon of the built-in set (for example file-plus, search, package). An unknown name shows no icon.

params.description: Static parameters passed to the screen (they become `params` in expressions).

requires.description: Permission (domain.resource.action) the user needs to see the item. The menu is only a convenience: the screen and the back end check permissions again.

visibleIf.description: Condition for showing the item, for example {{ settings.ordersEnabled }}; an error hides it. Always shown if absent.

id.description: Identifier of the group in kebab-case.

label.description: Text of the group in the menu: plain text or an expression such as {{ t('nav.orders', 'Orders') }}.

icon.description: Name of an icon of the built-in set (for example file-plus, search, package). An unknown name shows no icon.

requires.description: Permission (domain.resource.action) the user needs to see the group. The menu is only a convenience: the screen and the back end check permissions again.

visibleIf.description: Condition for showing the group, for example {{ settings.ordersEnabled }}; an error hides it. Always shown if absent.

children.description: Items inside the group, in order. A group without visible items disappears.

id.description: Identifier of the group in kebab-case.

label.description: Text of the group in the menu: plain text or an expression such as {{ t('nav.orders', 'Orders') }}.

icon.description: Name of an icon of the built-in set (for example file-plus, search, package). An unknown name shows no icon.

requires.description: Permission (domain.resource.action) the user needs to see the group. The menu is only a convenience: the screen and the back end check permissions again.

visibleIf.description: Condition for showing the group, for example {{ settings.ordersEnabled }}; an error hides it. Always shown if absent.

children.description: Items and groups inside the group, in order (a second level of groups at most).
